units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite>, end <he>חלקים היו כצ׳</he> they were as smooth as a nail, <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 34">Yalk. ib. 34</cite>. Koh. R. to VI, 7 <he>כצ׳ מתוך הושט</he> (the departure of the soul from the body is) like getting a nail out of the gullet, v. <cite ref="R00414"><he>צִיפּוֹרֵי</he> I</cite>; a. fr.—

Gen. R. s. 45 צִיפָּרְנָן של אבות ולא וכ׳ rather a nail of the fathers than the belly of the sons, i.e. the older generations were better than the latter; Yoma 9ᵇ טובה צִפּוֹרְנָן וכ׳.—Du. צִפּוֹרְנַיִים, צִפּוֹרְניִם, צִפָּרְ׳, צִי׳.
<cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 2:2">Tosef. M. Kat. II, 2</cite> <he>ליטול צ׳</he> to cut the nails; <cite ref="Moed Katan 17b">M. Kat. 17ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 2:5:5">Y. Hor. II, 46ᵈ</cite> <he>בצִיפָּרְנֵי ידיו</he> through his finger nails; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>דרך צִפּוֹרְנָיו</he>. Sifra Sh’mini, ch. IV, Par. 3 <he>צפורניים</he> the talons; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 537">Yalk. Lev. 537</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 1:2">Toh. I, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 121a">Ḥull. 121ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:1">Tosef. Sabb. XIV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:1">XV</cite>), 1 <he>צ׳ גדולה</he> a large spade; Y. ib. XVII, beg. 16ᵃ <he>הציפרין</he> (corr. acc.).
Y. Shek. VIII, beg. 51ᵃ אבא שאול היה קורא אותו צ׳ וכ׳ (not אותן) Abba Saul called it (the מְרִיצָה) tsipporen, because it resembles a nail.
